cross_channel.note: Current-derived channels share one transducer and signal path and are counted as a single family. The charge integral depends on both current and duration, so it corroborates neither. Unknown channels are not channels that stayed put.

current_integral_as.reason: the target's own change in this channel is unknown

peer_comparison.note: A change shared with comparable peers is evidence of a common influence - duty, environment, timetable or a fleet-wide change. It is not proof that the target's sensor failed. A channel is reported as not shared only where that channel has enough comparable peer evidence; otherwise it is unknown.

reference_comparison.reason: no reference views supplied; the adaptation effect is not visible
reference_comparison.note: A stable adapted baseline is not proof of health. The adapted and frozen indices are standardised by different scales, so their difference is not a quantity; only a baseline location difference in residual units, or on an explicitly named shared scale, is meaningful. A scale-only difference is not contamination evidence.

explanations.statement: A measurement or sensor change on this door would explain a shift confined to one measurement family. Independent channels also moved. That does not corroborate a single-transducer fault, and it does not exclude a sensor problem occurring alongside another change. 1 channel(s) were not observed, so they neither support nor contradict this.
suggested_inspection_evidence: Independent re-measurement of the affected channel on a few cycles
Records of any door control unit, sensor, wiring or firmware change since the reference window
Whether the same channel on the opposite leaf or paired door shows the shift

explanations.statement: A mechanical change on this door would explain a coherent shift across physically independent measurements. 1 channel(s) were not observed, so they neither support nor contradict this. Comparable peers did not show the change in: cycle_duration_s, mean_current_a.
suggested_inspection_evidence: Recorded observations of movement quality on a sample of cycles
Maintenance and parts history for this door since the reference window
Whether the affected channels continue to move together over the next few days

explanations.statement: Something common to these doors would explain a change they share - duty, environment, timetable, or a fleet-wide calibration or configuration change. This does not identify which, and does not establish a sensor fault.
suggested_inspection_evidence: Whether the shift starts on the same date across the comparable peers
Timetable, duty roster or service pattern changes covering the same dates
Fleet-wide software, calibration or configuration change records

explanations.statement: Reference adaptation may have absorbed a baseline level difference that the frozen fleet baseline still carries. The adaptation effect cannot be quantified: no reference views supplied; the adaptation effect is not visible.
suggested_inspection_evidence: Inspection or maintenance evidence covering the reference window itself
The frozen fleet baseline parameters for the same asset-days, alongside the adapted ones
Any commissioning or post-overhaul record explaining a persistent offset

explanations.statement: The available observations do not separate the explanations above.

limitation: Experimental evidence summary. It does not identify a cause, estimate a probability, or establish that any explanation is correct. It does not change alerts, aspects, urgency, deferral or service status.
